verified: Major-only setup starts unselected, previews three distinct subjects and six weekly lessons, preserves world resources on confirmation.
Desktop timetable has two lessons per subject, preserves one-off schedule, travels to the classroom, and viewing it never awards points.
Two classroom subjects independently gain 15 and 18 points while the third remains at zero; total 33 survives reload.

320px library reading exposes all 24 subjects and 25/25/50 percent cross-major outcomes before committing. Controlled inspiration: 17 minutes gives 25.5 points; controlled confusion: 19 minutes gives 9.5 points and 7 energy cost, morale -6, stress +6.
Cross-major total 35 is grouped separately from the three untouched major subjects; bookshop receipt and exact state survive reload without reroll or duplicate settlement.
1.9 migration preserves the original subject points, historic lesson, inventory and energy 67.25; adds the other two major subjects at zero and marks unknown historical outcome fields null.
Failed study save keeps the selected subject and exact saved state. Retry saves once, increases only the second subject by 15 and reduces energy to 64.25; draft and final state remain intact.
320 activity menu close/reopen and reading action pass hit testing. 320 and 390 cancel controls remain reachable and clear of the rescue button.

observations: Desktop shows three separate progress cards and readable subject-specific goals.
320 activity menu stays below mode controls; probability text is readable in the scrollable picker; external subject and recent penalty render clearly.
390 migration labels historical results without fabricating random effects. Failed-save message remains visible inside the picker, with cancellation fully above rescue control.
visualReview.note: Some screenshots intentionally show a scrolled section of a longer panel; all actionable controls are separately tested for reachability.

issues: 320 library activity menu overlapped the mode switch, preventing the reading action.
390 failed-save picker cancelled button lower edge overlapped rescue in visual inspection.
firstRun.resolution: Root constrained the mobile activity menu to a scrollable safe region with explicit close action and reserved 128px bottom space for study overlays. All three unique cases reran successfully against the final build.

boundaries.browser: Microsoft Edge desktop automation, single worker
boundaries.randomness: Duration and outcome are controlled in the two browser reward/penalty checks; this is not a statistical distribution test.
boundaries.bundleLoading: Exact final IIFE bytes served at a fixed localhost5178 fixture URL with size/hash response headers and completed resource verification.
boundaries.serverLifecycle: Playwright-managed 5178 server exited with the completed test run; no listening process remained.
